scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:integrity && npm run check:secrets

comments.typescriptPin: TypeScript is pinned to ~6.0.3 rather than latest, and the pin is deliberate. TypeScript 7.0.2 is the current latest, but typescript-eslint@8.71.1 declares `peer typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so TS7 refuses to install alongside the linter. 6.0.3 is the newest release inside the range the linter supports. Bump both together when typescript-eslint widens its peer range; do not --force past it, because a mismatched parser is how a lint rule silently stops seeing the file.
